content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Billings

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific credential requirements to ensure you meet the hours and experience thresholds. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document your background and confirm readiness before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Billings-based instructors deliver the full curriculum in real time, so you can ask questions and interact with peers across Montana. Upon completion, you'll receive your official certificate of attendance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI using your training certificate and work history. Pay the PMP examination fee as part of your application. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online submission process and answer eligibility questions.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and final review sessions to strengthen your test readiness. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center in Billings or online. You'll receive your PMP status from PMI immediately after passing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: PMP credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through project work, continuing education, and community involvement to satisfy PMI's renewal requirements. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to keep your skills current.
